_doc: The DexNav's lines (notes/DEXNAV.md; all NEW, approved by the user 2026-11-09). Route 101's text file (a/0/0/3 516) holds every DexNav line, so that Birch's Lab can show them too (ActorMsg and the DexNav's info op read any file: src/field_scripts/common/dexnav_defs.inc DN_T_*). b2tools/patches/text.py installs this file only when our C is on. Line breaks are the two characters \\n (as every override file's): a real newline would split a line in two and move every later line.
